response.sql: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING AVG(amount) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM budget), above_average AS (SELECT e.link_to_event, e.average_amount, e.average_amount - o.average_amount AS above_overall_by FROM event_averages e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE e.average_amount > o.average_amount) SELECT link_to_event, average_amount, above_overall_by, average_amount - AVG(average_amount) OVER () AS above_average_events_gap FROM above_average ORDER BY above_average_events_gap DESC LIMIT 10;
